text.otherCli: the `codex` CLI, with the brief written to a file and piped in on stdin (`codex exec --sandbox read-only - < brief.md`), never pasted as a command-line argument
text.transcripts: `~/.claude/projects/<workspace>/`, where `<workspace>` is the project's absolute path with every character that isn't a letter or digit replaced by `-` (very long paths are shortened, so match the folder by prefix). Several sessions can share the folder, so open the newest few `.jsonl` files and pick the one whose first user message matches this session
